name: POS Credit Checkout Test
description: Verifies that the POS page allows adding items, entering a Serial Number, and checking out via Credit.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /pos. If a login is required, log in with an available test account, then proceed to /pos.
Click on the first available product in the product grid to add it to the cart.
In the cart section, type 'SN-998877' into the Serial Number input field.
In the checkout modal, set the Payment Method to 'Credit', choose a credit customer, and click 'Complete Sale'.
Assert that a success notification is shown indicating the sale was completed.
